verified_source_results: Real HTTPS OTLP fixture accepts the prepared verifier and the consumer using protected delivered authorization and an actual protobuf trace after ambient credentials change.
Runtime, application and workload environments use the same selected authorization; owner-only runtime/application files are inspected.
Same-authority omitted authorization retains protected material. A different receiver cannot inherit old material; explicit anonymous destination access removes old headers.
Changed, malformed, duplicated and multiline authorization denies binding before either existing delivery projection changes; diagnostics do not disclose fixture secrets.
Redirect response is failure and receives no forwarding request containing custom authorization.
Public, symlinked, hardlinked and missing runtime owners cannot be reported verified or delivered to workloads; incomplete retained delivery cannot be silently rewritten.
Managed TLS client files remain byte-for-byte owned for recovery but their references are removed from external delivery; selecting managed delivery clears external authorization projections.

OIDC group/other-writable CA modes 0620, 0602 and 0666 are rejected; after-prepare chmod fails revalidation and preserves all original deliveries; positive readable 0644 CA HTTPS fixture remains green.

Unsupported Identity replacement displays concrete source/destination effects with Achtung and two current confirmations before technical admission; missing/partial/stale confirmations and unsupported execution preserve the original registry.
